sql.project.getAllForCompanyProcess: select p.id, cp.company_id, cp.process_id, p.customer_id, p.project_name from flow.company_process cp inner join flow.project p on cp.id = p.company_process_id where cp.company_id = :companyId and cp.process_id = :processId;
sql.project.get: select p.id, cp.company_id, cp.process_id, p.customer_id, p.project_name from flow.company_process cp inner join flow.project p on cp.id = p.company_process_id where p.id = :projectId
sql.project.insert: insert into flow.project (customer_id, company_process_id, project_name, created_by_id) values (:customerId, :processId, :projectName, :createdById)
sql.project.getAllForCustomer: select p.id, cp.company_id, cp.process_id, p.customer_id, p.project_name from flow.company_process cp inner join flow.project p on cp.id = p.company_process_id and p.id = :projectId where p.customer_id = :customerId;
sql.project.insertProjectProcessStep: insert into flow.project_process_step(project_id, process_step_id, user_position_id, company_process_step_status_type_id, created_by_id) values (:projectId, :processStepId, :userPositionId, :statusTypeId, :createdById)
sql.project.getProjectProcessStep: select ps.id as process_step_id, pps.id as project_process_step_id, ps.work_type_id as work_type_id, wt.work_type, pps.project_id, pps.process_step_complete_date, pps.user_position_id, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name as owner, coalesce(pps.date_modified, pps.date_created) as last_updated, cpsst.process_step_status_type_id, cpsst.process_step_status_type, ps.process_step_name from flow.project_process_step pps inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = pps.process_step_id inner join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on cpsst.id = pps.company_process_step_status_type_id inner join flow.work_type wt on wt.id = ps.work_type_id left join flow.user_position up on up.id = pps.user_position_id inner join flow.user u on u.id = up.user_id where pps.id = :stepId;
sql.project.getProcessStepsByProjectId: select ps.id as process_step_id, ps.work_type_id as work_type_id, wt.work_type, pps.id as project_process_step_id, pps.process_step_complete_date, pps.project_id, ps.process_step_name, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name as owner, coalesce(pps.date_modified, pps.date_created) as last_updated, cpsst.process_step_status_type, cpsst.process_step_status_type_id from flow.project p inner join flow.project_process_step pps on pps.project_id = p.id inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = pps.process_step_id inner join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on cpsst.id = pps.company_process_step_status_type_id inner join flow.work_type wt on wt.id = ps.work_type_id left join flow.user_position up on up.id = pps.user_position_id inner join flow.user u on u.id = up.user_id where p.id = :projectId order by last_updated;
sql.project.getAttachments: select a.id, a.size, a.date_created, a.date_modified, a.filename, a.attachment_type_id, a.content_type, a.s3_key from flow.project_attachment pa inner join flow.attachment a on a.id = pa.attachment_id where pa.project_id = :projectId;
sql.project.addAttachment: insert into flow.project_attachment(attachment_id, project_id, created_by_id) values (:attachmentId, :projectId, :createdById)
sql.project.getProjectProcessStepAttachments: select a.id, a.size, a.date_created, a.date_modified, a.filename, a.attachment_type_id, a.content_type, a.s3_key from flow.project_process_step_attachment ppsa inner join flow.attachment a on a.id = ppsa.attachment_id where ppsa.project_process_step_id = :projectProcessStepId
